 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Murahari Sri Raman

 01. 04.06.2025
This matter is taken up through Hybrid Mode.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

3. The petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.3269 of 2024,
pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Panposh, Rourkela, arising out of Raghunathpali P.S. Case No.613 of 2024 for commission of alleged offences under Sections 376/377/307/498-A/406/354/34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 read with Section 4 of D.P. Act, 1961.
4. Mr. Partha Sarathi Nayak, learned Additional Government Advocate prays for grant of some time to obtain the case diary.

5. List this matter along with ABLAPL No.14615 of 2024 before the assigned Bench on 25.06.2025.
6.
As an interim measure, it is directed that the petitioners shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the Signature Not Verified next date.
